conditional_sector_solutions_and_determi.scope: Numerical fixed-(N_up,N_down) sector energies, leading-determinant weights and amplitude-ranked truncated-space energies for the stored half-filled eight-site Hubbard ring and each stored disorder realization. Basis invariance is checked to 1e-8; determinant counts attain the stated 0.0016 target in hopping units for the chosen ranking, not a globally minimal determinant space.

disorder_sweep_basis_comparisons.scope: Observed basis-compactness comparisons on the declared four disorder strengths and three seeded site-disorder realizations per strength, with four bases per realization; the zero-strength rows repeat the clean model. These finite draws do not establish a universal disorder ranking or a population confidence guarantee.

pauli_word_and_logical_rotation_counts.scope: Counts of the explicitly represented rotated Hamiltonian Pauli words, determinant-space dimensions and rotations in the chosen Givens decomposition for the stored finite models; the logical rotation count excludes Jordan-Wigner mode-reordering and routed hardware costs and supplies no asymptotic or hardware advantage evidence.
